snippet.title: Beards Go Underground - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Beards Go Underground, a mining deckbuilding game developed by PandaBee Studios. Players will mine mountains by way of decks full of bombs and pickaxes at the ready. Seek the glory of gold in Beards Go Underground, coming soon to PC (Steam).

Wishlist the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4449650/Beards_Go_Underground

#BeardsGoUnderground #Gaming #IGN
